answer: Picture identities as ships docking at one wharf: each must post a non-refundable mooring toll that repays only through sustained honest grading across many epochs. An operator spinning up a hundred sybils at dawn pays a hundred tolls upfront, yet recoups at the throughput a single grader can sustain, so duplicates stay capital-negative. Genuine rare contribution becomes the opal in the heap; coordination cost, not raw key count, caps influence.
